sheets.name: S9F Definitions
sheets.title: S9F  Definitions and provenance
sheets.context: Definitions apply to all S9 parts. Table values are static outputs of the archived Python analysis.
rows: Post hoc internal robustness study; scenarios specified before inspecting robustness outputs. Not biological validation, accuracy validation, weight optimization or preregistration.
PRJNA1306560; Biomphalaria glabrata; 425 classified species-level features; 15 paired-end libraries
relative_percent: within-library percentages of species-level Bracken estimates; estimated_reads: Bracken estimated read counts. Neither is an absolute organism-load measurement.
425 sequence-classified taxonomic features. The supplied matrices use names rather than numeric TaxIDs. All-zero features are ineligible within a resample.

Prevalence is proportion >0. Means include zeros. Each abundance summary uses log10(v+1), then min-max across eligible taxa. Constant components map to zero. Scores rounded to 6 decimals before sorting; ties use decreasing prevalence, mean, maximum, then ascending taxon label. No taxon IDs are present in the supplied matrices.
Remove total and renormalize the remaining default weights to prevalence 0.50, mean 1/3 and maximum 1/6.
For a fixed sample count, total abundance equals sample count times mean abundance. Log transformation and min–max scaling do not make these summaries independent.
All 425 scores and exact ranks match in both representations. This verifies implementation fidelity, not biological validity.

All 81 joint products of four multipliers, multiplied by default weights and normalized to sum 1. Deduplicate exactly equivalent normalized weight vectors before analysis. Exactly 79 unique normalized vectors were evaluated.
default, equal_weights, no_prevalence, no_mean, no_maximum, no_total, total_weight_added_to_mean, prevalence_mean_equal, prevalence_only, mean_only
All S9A comparisons and S9D ranks use the historical default ranking as reference. Named baselines quantify ordering differences; they do not establish a superior method.

Use estimated-read thresholds of at least 10 or 50 to define presence only. Keep abundance summaries and the original normalization universe unchanged. These are sensitivity settings, not validated detection cutoffs.
This setting leaves presence unchanged because the smallest positive estimated-read entry is at least 10. A no-op scenario does not demonstrate robustness to stricter detection.
Retain taxa observed in at least 2 or 3 original libraries. Recompute min–max over retained taxa. Keep original abundance values and relative denominators; do not reclose percentages.
5,000 draws of five libraries with replacement within each of infected, infection_failed and uninfected. Identical draws are used for both representations and both score models.

Use identical draws across both representations and models. Recompute prevalence, all abundance summaries, active-taxon universe, log transforms, min-max and ranking in each draw. Retain original within-library relative-abundance denominators. Absent taxa are ineligible, with top-20 inclusion zero; summarize rank quantiles conditional on eligibility.
S9 Summary, S9B and the primary S9C metrics compare each model with its own full-sample ranking. Historical-default rank/top20 fields are supplied separately.
Top 10/20/50 and eligibility frequencies use all 5,000 draws. A taxon that is absent or ineligible contributes zero to inclusion frequencies.
Per-taxon rank quantiles and rank bounds use eligible draws/omissions only. Inspect eligibility frequency/count beside the rank summaries.
Empirical resampling percentiles summarize stability conditional on the observed libraries. They are not population confidence intervals or additional independent biological replication.
All 15 single-library omissions; group sizes become 4/5/5. Do not describe LOO as maintaining equal group counts.
Assign absent/ineligible taxa a common bottom tied rank; do not assign artificial distinct ranks by taxon name. The resulting statistic covers all 425 tracked features.
Number of features shared with the reference top k. Jaccard is intersection divided by union of the selected sets.
Median absolute displacement of the original reference top 20 positions. Consult the accompanying per-taxon eligibility information.
Report the joint grid separately from named ablations, presence rules and universe filters. A grid-specific range does not describe all scenarios. All specified adverse cases are retained in S9A.
Internal sensitivity and stability in this dataset; no optimized weights, external validation, confirmed taxonomic identity, biological importance, or accuracy superiority is established.
